title: Croatian Keto Zesty Spring Pasta
description: A keto pasta dish with a twist of Croatian flavors, featuring zesty and spring ingredients.

ingredients.name: Croatian prosciutto
ingredients.notes: High-quality, cured pork for a smoky flavor

ingredients.name: Parmesan cheese
ingredients.notes: Grated for a rich, savory flavor

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: High-quality, cold-pressed oil for added richness

instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the Croatian prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the spring onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the zesty garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the onion and garlic mixture.
Return the crispy prosciutto to the skillet and toss with the pasta.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
